threat_event: POS malware captures card data from front desk terminals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 180 semi-integrated terminals, not P2PE, on flat hotel staff networks
treatment_plan: Validated P2PE devices at front desks; interim segmentation

threat_event: Ransomware halts PMS interfaces, door locks, and front desks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat hotel networks; door lock servers on staff networks
existing_controls: PMS is vendor-hosted; emergency key cards
treatment_plan: Segment lock servers; test emergency key procedures

threat_event: Card numbers keyed by call center agents are captured on their desktops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 140 agents key card numbers into the PMS on general-purpose desktops
existing_controls: EDR; call recording paused during card entry
treatment_plan: Payment links or keypad entry so agents never hear or type card numbers

threat_event: PMS local accounts are misused, including the permission to view full virtual card numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,600 local accounts; 340 stale; 410 can view full card numbers
treatment_plan: PMS single sign-on through SYS-G1; remove full-number view except 2 roles

threat_event: Advertised room rates exclude the mandatory resort fee in some channels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Metasearch feed and two partner channels show rates without the $32 resort fee
treatment_plan: Total price in every channel feed; monthly channel audit

threat_event: Event-and-stay package checkout is skimmed through a tenant tag
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hotels tenant uses 4 marketing tags on checkout
treatment_plan: Remove tags from checkout (platform fix GR-01)

threat_event: Guest identity document numbers copied to the patron data platform are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly export includes ID numbers for about 1.9 million guests
treatment_plan: Stop the export of ID numbers and purge copies

threat_event: The revenue management system publishes rates to all channels without review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic publishing; no change log review
treatment_plan: Weekly rate review; register in the group AI inventory (P10)

threat_event: The channel manager is breached and exposes online travel agency virtual cards
treatment_plan: Obtain the AOC or replace the provider

threat_event: Hotel staff follow 2024 standards that conflict with group policy
The SAQ D cannot show which requirements group controls meet
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix before the SAQ is signed

threat_event: A PMS compromise cannot be scoped because logs are short and outside the SIEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PMS logs kept 90 days by the vendor
treatment_plan: Stream PMS logs to the SIEM with 1-year retention

threat_event: An attacker reaches the door lock system
Guest Wi-Fi traffic reaches staff networks
Card authorization forms emailed by group clients sit in sales mailboxes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group sales accepts forms by email
treatment_plan: Secure payment links for group billing; mailbox scan and purge

threat_event: Background check reports are disposed of improperly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper reports at hotel HR offices

threat_event: Guest register records are lost in a PMS change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Register kept in the PMS only
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Hotels security and compliance lead (Low)
